style: Readable hand-painted fantasy game art with flat-fill composition, visible gouache-like brushwork, and textured painted edges. Strong silhouettes and simplified forms that remain legible at small UI sizes. Mystical, quiet, slightly ominous tone rather than heroic spectacle. Use restrained dominant palettes with warm accent glows for magic, windows, embers, or healing light. Favor ancient floating ruins, impossible architecture, maze-etched surfaces, silent guardian presences, miniature settlements, cypress-like vertical shapes, blue-hour or golden-hour atmosphere, and long soft shadows when relevant. No text, logos, UI chrome, watermarks, frames, photorealism, or busy backgrounds.

types.spell: Square spell icon. Center one clear magical effect with strong shape language. Keep the mood mystical and quiet rather than explosive or heroic. Use high contrast, a clean silhouette readable at 64x64 pixels, and restrained color with warm accent glows. No character faces unless explicitly requested.
types.character: Square unit-frame avatar portrait. Bust or head-and-shoulders crop, clear face or creature identity, simple atmospheric backdrop. The asset should still read in a compact target frame.

assets.name: Heal
assets.prompt: A steady warm golden healing light, calm and reliable, like a basic efficient restorative spell.

assets.name: Patch
assets.prompt: A quick bright stitch of white-gold light closing a small tear, fast and urgent, like a swift practical patch-up mid-fight.

assets.name: Mend
assets.prompt: A broad deliberate wave of layered warm golden light knitting a deep wound closed, weighty and unhurried, the signature craft of a village mender.

assets.name: Renew
assets.prompt: A quiet green healing bloom made from simplified leaf shapes and warm gold inner light. The bloom feels ancient and restorative, like a soft recurring pulse of life rather than a burst. Dark muted green background, warm gold glow accents, clean centered silhouette.

assets.name: Shield
assets.prompt: A translucent blue-violet ward shaped like a compact domed shield, protecting one small warm golden spark at its center. Concentric runic arcs suggest sturdy magical absorption without using letters or text. Dark indigo background, cool luminous barrier, restrained gold core, clean centered silhouette.

assets.name: Lance
assets.prompt: A slender white-gold lancet of light piercing downward into a dark swollen orb, precise and surgical, releasing three small radiant droplets where it drains — a healer's tool turned on what festers. Keep the entire compact symbol inside generous dark padding, with a deep charcoal-blue background and a clean silhouette readable at 64x64 pixels.

assets.name: Nettle
assets.prompt: A single tall stinging nettle, elegant and bristling, its serrated leaves haloed by fine drifting stinging hairs that catch a pale light — a patient herbal sting that works over time. Make the whole plant one stark asymmetric emblem. For this icon, use a late-1970s French science-fiction comic mood: elegant precise ink contours, sparse cross-hatching and stipple, flat muted color fields, surreal stillness, and vintage print texture on a deep midnight blue-black background. Quiet, botanical and needling, with a clear silhouette readable at 64x64 pixels.

assets.name: Runt
assets.prompt: A small scrappy mud-flecked wolf with alert eyes, rough grey fur, and a mildly dangerous expression — an animal having a bad day.

assets.name: Tank
assets.prompt: A sturdy fantasy tank adventurer in worn plate armor, protective stance, practical and dependable.

assets.name: Player
assets.prompt: A focused healer adventurer with simple robes, kind but determined expression, carrying soft restorative magic.
